name: Light Footmen
description: Easy to train, quick to field.

buff.name: To Arms
buff.text: When an allied officer in the same zone makes or is targeted by a melee attack, they gain an Advantage on their roll to attack/defend.

features: This division may be issued an order as a Minor Action while unbroken.
If there is at least one allied officer in this division’s zone, whenever an enemy division moves out of this zone, the border is considered Hazardous unless the division is flying.

name: Heavy Footmen

buff.name: To Arms
buff.text: When an allied officer in the same zone makes or is targeted by a melee attack, they gain an Advantage on their roll to attack/defend.

features: If there is at least one allied officer in this division’s zone, whenever an enemy division moves out of this zone, the border is considered Hazardous unless the division is flying.

name: Bowmen

buff.name: Projectile Cloud
buff.text: Whenever an allied officer in the same zone makes an attack with a ranged weapon, they gain the Startling damage effect.

features: When this division attacks divisions with the Flying type, the Difficulty is reduced by 1.

name: Ballista
features: When this division makes an attack, the ordering officer uses their Study instead of Authority for the task.
This division may attack any division in an adjacent zone, increasing the Difficulty of 1.
All zone borders are considered Hazardous for this division.
When this division attacks divisions with the Flying type, the Difficulty is reduced by 1.

name: Light Horse Cavalry
description: Horseback riders, good for scouting ahead.

buff.name: Gallop
buff.text: A mounted allied officer that starts their turn in the same zone may take the movement minor action for free.

features: This division can make two Free Moves every round. An officer may order this division to Free Move even if they have already ordered a Free Move this turn.

name: Heavy Horse Cavalry
description: Horseback riders, good for breaking enemy ranks.

buff.name: Chargers
buff.text: If a mounted allied officer starts their turn in the same zone, they gain an additional 2[CD] on the first melee attack they make.

features: When this division makes an attack the same turn it enters a zone, it deals an extra 2[CD] damage and gains the Startling damage effect.

name: Horse Archers
description: Talented riders able to fire bows from atop a steed.

buff.name: Gallop
buff.text: A mounted allied officer that starts their turn in the same zone may take the movement minor action for free.

features: This division can make two Free Moves every round. An officer may order this division to Free Move even if they have already ordered a Free Move this turn.
When this division attacks divisions with the Flying type, the Difficulty is reduced by 1.

name: Mages

buff.name: Arcane Expertise
buff.text: Once per round, when an allied officer in the same zone casts a spell with arcane magick, they may treat their relevant skill as one higher, to a maximum of 6, for the task.

features: Officers may use Reason instead of Presence when issuing Orders to this division.

name: Pegasi Cavalry

buff.name: Free Flying
buff.text: When an allied officer with a flying mount takes the Move or Sprint actions while in the same zone as this division, their speed is increased by 1 and they do not provoke Opportunity Attacks until the end of their turn.

features: This division can make two Free Moves every round. An officer may order this division to Free Move even if they have already ordered a Free Move this turn.
This division is not affected by difficult terrain.

name: Griffin Cavalry

buff.name: Swoopers
buff.text: Whenever an allied officer with a flying mount in the same zone makes a melee attack, they may roll an additional die.

features: This division is not affected by difficult terrain.

name: Medical Unit
description: Trained Medics capable of revitalizing injured soldiers.

buff.name: Triage
buff.text: When an allied officer in the same zone takes the First Aid major action, they may target any officer in the same zone regardless of distance.

features: Officers in the same zone as this division may issue the Regroup order as a Minor Action.

name: Military Band
description: Musicians playing to inspire soldiers in battle.

buff.name: War Drums
buff.text: Allied officers in the same zone roll an extra die on Console and Demoralize tasks.

features: At the end of each round, all unbroken allied divisions in the same zone as this division regain 1 morale.

name: Tactical Corps
description: Strategic thinkers who help analyze the battlefield.

buff.name: Order Runners
buff.text: Officers within the same zone as this division may issue orders to divisions in adjacent zones as if they were in that zone.

features: When this division enters a zone with an enemy division, the ordering officer may ask one question about the opposing army as if using the Obtain Information momentum spend.

name: Mangonel
description: Shorter ranged but more flexible catapults.
features: When this division makes an attack, the ordering officer uses their Study instead of Authority for the task.
This division may attack structures within or along the border of its current zone.
This division may attack any division in an adjacent zone, increasing the Difficulty by 1.

name: Trebuchet
description: Siege weapons capable of striking from afar.
features: When this division makes an attack, the ordering officer uses their Study instead of Authority for the task.
When making an attack, this division can target any division in an adjacent zone, or a structure in or along the border of any adjacent zone. This division cannot attack targets in the same zone.
All zone borders are considered Hazardous for this division.
